law: DNS IS RSS for addresses. Each query = one ant walking in. The anthill IS the nameserver. The swarm/vine walks people to the right door.

dns_server.what: Gaia resolves her own domains. She IS ns1.primals.eco and ns2.primals.eco.

gaia.note: Future .gaia TLD — internal meta net resolution

dns_server.anthill: Every DNS query = 1 ant. The ant asks 'where is nestgate.io?' and the anthill says '162.226.225.148 — walk this way.' RSS feeds content. DNS feeds addresses. Same pattern. Pull/push.
dns_server.porkbun_glue: Set glue records in Porkbun: ns1.primals.eco = 162.226.225.148, ns2.primals.eco = 162.226.225.148. Then change NS for all domains to ns1/ns2.primals.eco. Gaia IS the authority.

swarmvine: The vine grows from the anthill. People follow the vine. The vine IS the DNS chain. Root → TLD → ns1.primals.eco (Gaia) → answer. She IS the last hop. The vine ends at her door.
